assertions.sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name
SELECT p.name, COUNT(o.id)::int AS antal FROM products p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY antal, p.name
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND p.category = 'Drikke') ORDER BY c.name
